## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm run test`
- [ ] `pnpm run build`
- [ ] Relevant keyboard, accessibility, responsive, and visual checks
- [ ] Documentation and generated agent artifacts updated when required
- [ ] Public contract snapshot reviewed when API or stable tokens changed

## Compatibility

Describe any public API, behavior, accessibility, styling, bundle-size, or migration impact. Write “None” when the change is internal.
